- [GitHub raw JSON fallback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaulTiffany/Principia-Symbolica/main/principia_atlas.json): Secondary transport mirror; the GitHub Pages JSON remains canonical.
- [Book doorway](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/)
